chronology: PPR and popularity were validated, selected and submitted first
a bounded repeat experiment followed, and its two candidates were then submitted
all four Kaggle score pairs were observed
only then was this exploratory experiment requested, so nothing here is pre-Kaggle evidence

observed_kaggle_scores.use: context only; excluded from acceptance and selection

hypothesis: PPR personalization is less reliable for sparse histories, so lowering its fusion weight for those users may improve validation
target_note: local Top-5 preference and broad watched-set targets are assumptions; Kaggle's hidden target is unknown, and neither local target changes here

frozen_components.popularity: distinct training users with a watched airing

fusion: score(i) = w_u / (10 + rank_ppr(i)) + (1 - w_u) / (10 + rank_popularity(i)), complete rankings, K = 10
comparison: fixed w = 0.8, K = 10 fusion on the same fold

variants.name: adaptive_days
variants.label: B
variants.history: distinct Kyiv calendar dates of the airing starts of positive labelled training interactions

rules: history is computed from the fold's training side only
users with no training positive receive popularity directly
ties break by ascending numeric id
no other variant, threshold, weight or K may be added
acceptance_rule: a variant qualifies only if its primary MAP@5 strictly exceeds fixed w = 0.8 fusion on BOTH the main split and the stability fold
selection_rule: if both qualify, take the larger main-split primary MAP@5; an exact tie goes to A
no_qualifier: stop with the results and generate no CSV
